CamperIvanSeenText:
I've been getting
#MON data off

my radio. I think
I'm good.
CamperIvanAfterBattleText:
Music on the radio
changes the moods of wild #MON.
CamperElliotSeenText:
I'm gonna show my
girlfriend I'm hot stuff!
CamperElliotBeatenText:
I wish you would
have lost for me…
CamperElliotAfterBattleText:
I was humiliated
in front of my girlfriend…
PicnickerBrookeSeenText:
My boyfriend's
weak, so I can't rely on him.
PicnickerBrookeAfterBattleText:
I can count on my
#MON more than my boyfriend.
PicnickerKimSeenText:
Are you going to
the GYM? Me too!
PicnickerKimAfterBattleText:
The GYM BADGES are
pretty. I collect them.
BirdKeeperBryanSeenText:
What kinds of
BALLS do you use?
BirdKeeperBryanAfterBattleText:
Some #MON flee
right away.

Try catching them
with KURT's FAST BALL.

Whenever I find a
WHT APRICORN, I take it to KURT.

He turns it into a
custom BALL.
JugglerIrwinAfterBattleText:
I was going to
dazzle you with my prize #MON.

But your prowess
electrified me!
BugCatcherArnieSeenText:
I'll go anywhere
if bug #MON appear there.
BugCatcherArnieBeatenText:
Huh? I shouldn't
have lost that…
BugCatcherArnieAfterBattleText:
My VENONAT won me
the Bug-Catching

Contest at the
NATIONAL PARK.
BugCatcherArnieYanmaText:
Wow… Look at all
those YANMA!

I'm so blown away,
I can't move.
FirebreatherWaltBeatenText:
Ow! I scorched the
tip of my nose!
FirebreatherWaltAfterBattleText:
The #MON March
on the radio lures wild #MON.
OfficerDirkAfterBattleText:
You know, night-
time is fun in its own ways.

But don't overdo
it, OK?
OfficerDirkPrettyToughText:
Your #MON look
pretty tough.

You could go any-
where safely.
